title: Grateful Dead Live at Zoo Amphitheatre on 1982-08-01
lineage: 2nd GEN Cassettes > Nakamichi Cassette Deck 2 (azimuth adjusted) > Kind Kables RCA/XLR > Lunatec V3 (@24 bit 96 kHz) > coax > Audiophile 2496 > WaveLab 5.0 > 24 bit WAV > Waves L3 UltraMaximizer(dither) > 16 bit WAV > CD Wave Editor > TLH > FLAC16
source: (FOB) Nakamichi CM-700s > Sony TC-D5M > MC > Cassette x2

ai_review.summary: Audience cassette of Jerry’s 40th‑birthday show captures a decent second set (Playing > Iko Iko, The Wheel) but suffers from multiple cassette generations and Dolby noise, making the sound only fair.
ai_review.review: The performance is memorable for its birthday context and a strong second set that lifts the heat‑weary night with a smooth transition from Playing in the Band into Iko Iko and a standout version of The Wheel. However, the recording comes from a second‑generation audience cassette with Dolby hiss, so the audio quality is uneven and best suited for fans who were there or who value the ambience over fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating (3.8) with reviewers split between praise for the second‑set music and criticism of tape quality; enough reviews to gauge but some contradictions keep confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Second‑generation cassette copies with Dolby noise; sound is decent for an audience tap but shows hiss, generational loss and occasional muffling.

standout_songs: Playing in the Band > Iko Iko
poor_songs: Lost Sailor / Saint of Circumstance (mentioned as ‘lost’)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set hampered by extreme heat and fatigue, but the second set recovers with a smooth open (Playing > IKO) and solid finishes.
